label: Remnant officer
note: Issue #64: the officer Oda puts a price on. A red Remnant at one of the desert outposts (WorldState.bounty names which); killing them makes the bounty collectable at the fence. Tougher than a trooper, and the name floats over them from further away so you know who you are hunting. Issue #76: carries a dark pistol (CharacterKit._pistol), not a rifle, and shoots straighter than the troopers round them.
